shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
curvilinear incised motifs covering the surface
symmetrical/paired arrangement of motifs about a central axis
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow incised relief with rings/discs and bilaterally symmetric motifs arranged about a vertical centre-line, but that is about as generic as correspondence gets. A shows an abstract, blocky anthropomorphic monolith with a few isolated circular and crescent-like signs on an otherwise plain back, whereas B shows a narrative scene of winged, human-headed and bird-headed figures flanking an elaborate stylised plant, above a dense band of inscribed script — no figures, plant or text appear in A.
